body:
I am currently looking on V3: Session Management Verification Requirements. I was wondering, how the requirements there address security of stateless apps that rely on - let's say - JWT tokens (which happen to be really popular right now). My understanding is - they don't. I searched through the whole ASVS 3.0.1 and did not find any points mentioning JWT.

Did I miss something? Or are the stateless apps out of the picture on purpose?
title: Requirements for session-less apps
